text:
incidentbot: :rotating_light: Pager: SLA breach detected for tenant=acme-corp check=generate-latency-95 condition=over_threshold(>300ms) count=7
sara: I'm on it. seeing repeated 95th latency spikes from a small subset of pods in us-east-1.
miguel: copying — can you post the raw alerts?
sara: pasted below. looks like a noisy heartbeat synthetic check (tenant-specific) firing on retries.
sara: ```alertname: TenantGenerateLatency95
tenant: acme-corp
value: 412ms
check_id: tenant-gen-95
query: p95(latency{tenant="acme-corp",route="/generate"})```
dave: reassigning to eng-sre per runbook 6.2 (tenant noisy checks). @jamie FYI for customer comms.
jamie: noted — will stand by for impact numbers. any errors or just slow?
sara: mostly latency spikes, a few 500s (~0.4% of requests in window). customer on Dedicated.
ops-bot: Created incident INC-2026-981 for SLA alert — link: https://redwood/infra/incidents/INC-2026-981
miguel: short-term mitigation: can we debounce the tenant-specific check for 5m and add a temporary silence?
sara: doing debounce + silence now. command: `alertctl silence tenant-gen-95 --tenant acme-corp --for 5m --reason "flapping heartbeat during mitigation"`
sara: applied. will also add a temporary threshold bump to 400ms for this tenant to avoid paging while we investigate.
dave: prefer debounce + increase threshold vs full disable. we still need visibility. create a grafana panel for the tenant 95/99.
miguel: creating dashboard now — quick query and panel id: 6721. link: https://grafana/redwood/d/tenant-95?panelId=6721
jamie: for customer comms: is impact material? they saw slowdowns in background jobs and a handful of failed prompts. will escalate if >1% errors.
sara: current error rate 0.42% in last 10m. SLA window shows p95 breach but p99 still ok.
dave: action: add tenant-level noise filter in monitoring pipeline (drop single-sample spikes if adjacent samples are < threshold). that's a medium-term fix.
miguel: quick patch I can push: in monitoring rules, change `evaluation_interval` for tenant-gen-95 from 1m to 30s and add `for: 2m` to avoid one-off spikes. also bump threshold to 400ms in config:```yaml
- alert: TenantGenerateLatency95
  expr: p95(latency{tenant="acme-corp",route="/generate"}) > 400
  for: 2m
```
sara: applied the rule edit and reloaded prom. will watch.
incidentbot: Silence applied: tenant-gen-95 (5m) by sara.
ops-bot: Note: created post-incident ticket TCK-1243 to instrument per-tenant synthetic traffic for acme-corp and add pre-aggregation of heartbeat metrics.
jamie: putting together short note for acme-corp: low % of errors, mitigations applied, follow-ups scheduled.
dave: follow-ups: (1) add noise-filtering to monitoring pipeline, (2) add tenant watchlist + synthetic, (3) dashboard with 95/99/err-rate, (4) evaluate KV cache / batching impact on p95 for that tenant.
miguel: I'll own (1) and (4) — will run load test with synthetic traffic after changes.
sara: will update the runbook with a tenant-scope debounce example and CLI snippets.
jamie: ETA for customer note? 30m?
sara: yes, will post a short update in 20m.
dave: after this settles, schedule a follow-up meeting with product for configuration defaults (tenant threshold overrides). this pattern popping up in 2 customers this week.
miguel: +1 — also propose a new consolidated dashboard and an alert grouping rule to avoid multiple pages for the same tenant.
sara: closing loop: silence ends at +5m from now; if alerts stop but metrics still elevated, we'll keep silence and rely on dashboard. otherwise revert threshold change. tracking in INC-2026-981.
incidentbot: Incident INC-2026-981 status: mitigated -> monitoring.
jamie: posted customer note draft to the incident doc, requesting approval. @dave pls review.
dave: LGTM. good job everyone. :thumbsup:
ops-bot: Follow-up checklist added to ticket INC-2026-981:
- Add host/tenant filters to alert pipeline
- Create tenant watchlist for acme-corp
- Add dashboard panel (panelId=6721)
- Update runbook with debounce example
- Postmortem in 48h
sara: will own the runbook update and the postmortem note. tagging this thread to the postmortem doc.
jamie: thanks all — closing out on-call actions unless anyone still needs the handoff.
miguel: I'm good. handing back to night oncall.
sara: handoff complete.
incidentbot: Thread archived to INC-2026-981 after status change."
